_note: agentbox's Seatbelt backend on macOS (sandbox-exec), as a normal user. The host's kernel and network stack: no kernel.isolation, no memory/cpu/pids limits (macOS has no per-sandbox cap), no network.outbound; egress is restricted through the run's gateway on a loopback port (HTTPS_PROXY), model proxies on loopback ports, nothing else reachable. Containment kills the commands' process groups and every process still under the sandbox's profile (cgo build).
